query: I have a 42-year-old female. Among female ICU patients aged 37–47, what's the 75th percentile of mean temperature per stay?
final_sql:
WITH eligible_patients AS (
    SELECT 
        subject_id,
        -- Calculate birth date from anchor_year and anchor_age
        DATE_SUB(CAST(CONCAT(anchor_year, '-01-01') AS DATE), INTERVAL anchor_age YEAR) AS birth_date
    FROM `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients`
    WHERE gender = 'F'
      AND anchor_year IS NOT NULL
      AND anchor_age IS NOT NULL
),
icu_stays AS (
    SELECT 
        i.subject_id,
        i.hadm_id,
        i.stay_id,
        i.intime,
        i.outtime,
        -- Calculate age at ICU admission
        FLOOR(DATEDIFF(i.intime, ep.birth_date) / 365.25) AS age_at_icu
    FROM `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_icu.icustays` i
    JOIN eligible_patients ep ON i.subject_id = ep.subject_id
    WHERE age_at_icu BETWEEN 37 AND 47
),
temperature_measurements AS (
    SELECT
        ce.subject_id,
        ce.hadm_id,
        ce.stay_id,
        ce.charttime,
        ce.valuenum,
        ce.valueuom,
        -- Convert to Celsius if necessary
        CASE 
            WHEN ce.valueuom = 'F' THEN (ce.valuenum - 32) * 5/9
            ELSE ce.valuenum
        END AS temp_celsius
    FROM `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_icu.chartevents` ce
    JOIN icu_stays is_ 
        ON ce.subject_id = is_.subject_id
        AND ce.hadm_id = is_.hadm_id
        AND ce.stay_id = is_.stay_id
        AND ce.charttime BETWEEN is_.intime AND is_.outtime
    JOIN (
